bug_url: internal: shrink ray JSON deepcopy/recursion overflow (fixed in this repo)
symptom: Regression evaluation for shrink ray's own deep-nesting robustness. shrink ray's JSON passes copy and walk the parsed structure (deepcopy), recursing per nesting level, and json.loads itself recurses while decoding; deeply nested JSON overflowed the recursion limit and crashed shrink ray. This entry is a realistic config document with one 600-level nested array; reducing it must not crash shrink ray and should shrink it to a minimal deeply nested array. The interestingness test runs the relevant bit of code directly (json.loads) and requires valid JSON nested at least 300 levels deep.
